objective: Make Mission Control readable and actionable for Japanese operators.
reason_for_work: Operators could not quickly understand task state, organization shape, product completion, or test/audit status from the previous English-first Mission Control surface.
expected_output: Japanese Mission Control shell and labels
hierarchical organization view with member utilization
product completion view derived from requirements/features
consumer: AOF adopters using Japanese browser translation or native Japanese UI
success_criteria: Mission Control renders Japanese labels without relying on browser auto-translation
task status is available as Kanban and list views with old done tasks hidden by default
organization hierarchy and role utilization are visible from runtime artifacts
product completion is summarized from requirement/task coverage signals
test/audit status is visible from runtime evidence

go: focused Mission Control runtime test passes
no_go: UI-only change without canonical runtime mapping
